correctness.rationale: The complete 60-facet presentation reconstructs f=(12,66,144,150,60). After contracting a spanning tree, unimodular integral reduction of all 144 triangular-face relations gives 54 unit Smith factors and one free generator, so H1 is Z. An explicit integral cocycle annihilates every facial relation and evaluates to a unit on a triangular cycle, hence gives exact generator coordinates. Every one of the 76 nonfacial triangles evaluates to +1 or -1. Exhaustive triangle-preserving permutation backtracking followed by full facet verification finds exactly 96 automorphisms, with carrier orbits 12,48,16 and induced H1 actions split 48/48 between +1 and -1.

value.rationale: The example is a highly symmetric, neighborly small triangulation of the nonorientable S3-bundle over the circle, so missing triangles are the entire first possible simple-loop layer. Proving that every one of the 76 missing two-faces is a primitive generator, and then resolving that complete layer into exactly three full-symmetry types while the automorphism group realizes both H1 signs, gives a natural combinatorial systolic invariant not determined by the known homology, f-vector, or automorphism-group order.
